recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No additional core source work is needed for FHIR-41760 unless Pharmacy later changes author target profiles or asks for extra narrative guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-41760 was an Applied/Persuasive Pharmacy issue asking whether MedicationStatement.informationSource should cover asserter or author semantics, or whether a separate asserter/author element should be added. The resolution states that informationSource is not intended to be author and that MedicationStatement.author should be added.
initial_application: Commit 6f3b7f9adb474ef110338f51ec20bc616ef73f12 applied FHIR-41760 by adding MedicationStatement.author as a 0..1 Reference to Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Organization, Patient, RelatedPerson, or Device. The combined branch already contained this source commit, but it did not have an Issue-Reconcile-Key audit for FHIR-41760.
additional_context: FHIR-5508 is the earlier Pharmacy issue that added informationSource instead of author for medication reconciliation source tracking. FHIR-41760 is the later, more specific decision that preserves informationSource semantics while adding author separately. Existing AutoFHIR commit 4050637eea8605693701d2ca0f0af9e0d4948c4e already reconciled related FHIR-41500 wording for informationSource.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current build-scope StructureDefinition already includes the requested author element and the separate informationSource element.
